claimBoundary: One unblinded local historical task with one sequential warm-context observation per condition and prompt profile. It cannot establish general routing quality, Token savings, or speed.

naturalLanguage.description: The historical repair intent without file, class, method, or function identities.
naturalLanguage.interpretation: No routing, payload, or practical timing difference was observed.

explicitIdentity.description: The same repair with the actual implementation identities and focused-test path supplied explicitly.
explicitIdentity.interpretation: Both versions achieved complete changed-file coverage with the same route. The candidate used 104 more estimated Tokens and was slower in this single observation.

generalMechanismFindings: Natural-language routing remains weak when the task lacks navigable code identities.
The public baseline already closes this explicit-identity task, so the candidate adds no route-quality value here.
Selection evidence status can disagree with final route evidence closure after the explicit-symbol contract is applied.
Warm context latency around 70 seconds remains unacceptable for an interactive workflow.
